source_excerpt: `source` lets the consumer attribute DTMF correctly when bridging across substrates (e.g., distinguish in-band SIP DTMF that survived translation from native UCTP DTMF).

verification.scope: Local source-field attribution: actual native INFO-method requests remain uctp-native; actual initial SIP INFO and RFC4733 inputs retain their physical source kinds. SDK verifies signatures. This does not qualify all gateway legs, WebRTC, fanout or full DTMF delivery.

sip_producer: production_initial_sip_received_info_and_rfc4733_keep_actual_provenance_and_sealed_audience: actual INFO and negotiated RTP event inputs retain sip-info/rfc4733 in signed native output and HTTP status.
attribution_implementation: Native Capture derives observation from authenticated NativeDtmfObservation rather than payload source claims.
Received observation conversion accepts only actual SIP INFO/RFC4733 kinds; routing requires the same original physical observation and output source value.
Source and recipient permission/audience/lifecycle checks gate actual IO; no fabricated native signing custody is accepted for SIP.
limits: This qualifies the source-field attribution clause for the recorded native/loopback-SIP profile, not all gateway delivery.
Other gateway legs, WebRTC source, full group/transport/privacy/recovery and gate acceptance remain open under their assigned requirements. No other clause or task credit.
